bash: python3 -c "import rdflib; g=rdflib.Graph(); g.parse('/app/university_graph.ttl',format='turtle'); q='''PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?name ?role ?country ?dept (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?n)
WHERE {
  ?p a uni:Person ; uni:hasName ?name ; uni:role ?role ; uni:worksIn ?dept .
  FILTER(REGEX(LCASE(STR(?role)), \"^(full )?professor\"))
  ?dept uni:belongsTo ?u . ?u uni:locatedInCountry ?country .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?course uni:isTaughtIn ?dept .
    ?student uni:isEnrolledIn ?course ; uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?enrolled .
    FILTER(?enrolled <= \"2025-08-16\"^^xsd:date)
    OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?grad . }
    FILTER(!BOUND(?grad) || ?grad > \"2025-08-16\"^^xsd:date)
  }
}
GROUP BY ?name ?role ?country ?dept
ORDER BY ?name ?dept'''; res=g.query(q); print('name | role | country | dept | n'); [print(f'{r[0]} | {r[1]} | {r[2]} | {r[3]} | {r[4]}') for r in res]"
